name: pulse-architecture-boundaries
description: Defines React component architecture boundaries in this Laravel Inertia app. Use when choosing component type, file placement, state ownership, composition shape, hook extraction, helper extraction, or page-section boundaries.
purpose: Keep components coherent, reusable only when justified, and aligned with project structure.
single_responsibility: Define component type, file placement, state ownership, and hook/helper extraction boundaries aligned with Inertia and project structure.
triggers: New component, file placement, or hook/helper extraction is needed
Choosing between primitive, compound, feature, section, or page component
Deciding where shared behaviour or pure logic should live
completion_criteria: Component type is classified as primitive, compound, feature, section, or page
File placement follows local structure with no new base directories without approval
Hook and helper extraction decisions are justified, not speculative
Cross-cutting concerns are routed to their owning skills
validation_criteria: API design has a clear input
failure_handling: If component boundaries cannot be settled without a missing reuse decision or convention, stop and report the dependency instead of guessing structure.
Report the chosen boundaries and any deferred structural decisions.
escalation_path: Route public or reusable API decisions to pulse-api-contract.
Route state, effects, and hydration concerns to pulse-state-effects.
Route uncertain framework structure to pulse-docs-research.
Escalate new base directories or dependency changes to the user.
responsibilities: Keep boundaries aligned with Inertia and project conventions.
Keep server/page boundaries, client-only effects, and shared primitives explicit enough to avoid hydration drift.
